name: DirectDebitInstruction
description: Represents a Direct Debit Instruction (DDI) — the authorisation given by a customer (payer) to an originator permitting that originator to collect payments from the customer's account via the BACS scheme. Created when the bank (as paying PSP) receives an AUDDIS 0N instruction or when the customer sets up a DDI via the digital channel. The DDI is the central entity for the BACS Direct Debit mandate lifecycle. Part of the JRN-012 Direct Debit Setup and First Collection journey.

fields.name: ddi_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated by SVC-009. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: account_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → Account.account_id (ENT-004, CAP-001/SVC-001). Must reference an active account. Validated via cross-capability event at PH-047. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: originator_name
fields.validation_rule: Required. Max 18 characters (BACS field limit). Originator organisation name.

fields.name: originator_sun
fields.validation_rule: Required. 6-digit BACS Service User Number. Numeric string. Must be validated against BACS SUN directory at PH-047.

fields.name: reference
fields.validation_rule: Required. Max 18 characters. Originator-assigned customer reference. Must be unique per originator_sun on active instructions for the same account_id.

fields.name: fixed_amount
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when amount_type = fixed. Positive decimal, max 2 decimal places (GBP). Null when amount_type = variable.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: pending | active | cancelled | suspended. Transitions: pending → active (BACS confirmation, PH-048); active → cancelled (AUDDIS 0C); active → suspended (bank-initiated).

fields.name: setup_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Date of EVT-069 publication. Immutable.

fields.name: first_collection_date
fields.validation_rule: Optional. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Expected first collection date. Informational only.

fields.name: bacs_reference
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required after status = active. BACS-assigned scheme reference. Null while status = pending.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Updated on any mutation.

relationships.description: DirectDebitInstruction belongs to one Account. FK: account_id → Account.account_id. Cross-capability reference (ENT-004 owned by CAP-001/SVC-001).
One DirectDebitInstruction may have multiple DirectDebitCollection records.

design_decisions.decision: ENT-034 is owned by SVC-009 (CAP-003), not SVC-001 (CAP-001).
design_decisions.rationale: The DDI is a BACS scheme artefact. Its lifecycle (AUDDIS, collection, indemnity) is entirely within Payment Operations (CAP-003). The account_id is a cross-capability FK reference — ownership follows domain responsibility.
